title: the thread close gate never reads WP status, so a thread closes Completed over Not Started work packages that carry no ACs -- and ST0057 is one command from it
body:
`st done` closes a thread on the criteria contract alone. **The whole path is read, not inferred:** `st_done` -> `st_done_listing` -> `set_thread_status`, which runs the self-loop test, `check_transition`, `check_gate(("Thread","status","st.done"), id, id, Scope::Thread)`, `check_reason`, then `closing_notes`. `check_gate` calls `gate(thread, Scope::Thread, refs)`, which counts criteria and nothing else; `closing_notes` reports UNSYNCED ATTACHMENTS and nothing else. **No step on that path reads `WorkPackage.status`, and no step prints it.**

At WP scope the model is deliberate and announced: `an_ac_free_wp_rolls_up_and_says_so` fixes the ratified behaviour -- asking about an AC-free WP answers `PASS -- no ACs in scope; rolls up to the ST0001 contract`, and issue 0004's sibling test keeps a typo'd WP from inheriting that rollup. **That is WP scope. Nothing covers the thread-scope question**, which is the one `st done` asks.

**LIVE INSTANCE, MEASURED, NOT CONSTRUCTED:** `intent ac gate ST0057` reports `PASS -- 66/66 satisfied, 3 withdrawn`. `intent wp list ST0057` shows fourteen work packages, of which **WP-12 (`Issues get a realised form and a sigil, then join the default declaration`) and WP-13 (`The v2 tree survives migration and disagrees with the store: ingest buckets`) are `Not Started`**. Both carry **zero ACs and zero ATs** -- every other WP prefix (00-11, 14) carries between 2 and 8. So the 66 criteria are silent about them by construction, and the thread is one `st done` from recording Completed over two declared, unbuilt work packages with nothing said.

**THIS IS A GREEN FROM AN INSTRUMENT THAT COULD NOT HAVE ANSWERED DIFFERENTLY, AND THE GREEN GETS CITED.** `PASS -- 66/66` is TRUE. It is also read by every operator as "this thread is finished", which is the reading the gate cannot support and does not qualify.

**THE RULING THIS NEEDS IS A DESIGN QUESTION AND IS NOT FILED HERE AS A DEFECT.** Two defensible readings:

1. **The contract is the authority.** An AC-free WP's contract IS the thread's, per the ratified rollup -- so a passing thread contract leaves such a WP nothing outstanding, and `status` is work-tracking rather than contract. Under this reading the behaviour is correct and the only gap is that nobody wrote it down.
2. **`done` should not be assertable over `Not Started`.** A thread recording Completed while declaring unbuilt work packages makes "Completed" mean something weaker than every reader takes it to mean. Remedy would be a refusal, or -- cheaper and consistent with how this estate handles announced exemptions -- a note on the close naming the open WPs, in the same place `closing_notes` already speaks.

**Related:** `0116` is the same shape one layer down (the model cannot express partial coverage, so a half-covered criterion gates green); this is the model unable to express *unbuilt scope carrying no criteria*, so an incomplete thread gates green. Both are the gate being blind to something nobody encoded rather than the gate being wrong.
